meta.title: Collection System
meta.description: Personal collection organization and semantic search

directory.noResultsDetail: No title, summary, or tag matched. No AI was called.

public.empty: The collection has nothing to show yet

ask.emptyDetail: This answer will not be filled with knowledge outside the collection.
ask.limited: Today’s question limit has been reached. Try again later
ask.limitedDetail: No model was called for this request.
ask.errorDetail: Your question is preserved. Please retry.
ask.disabledEmpty: The collection is empty, so questions are disabled.

login.title: Admin sign in
login.invalid: The username or password is incorrect. The failed attempt was recorded.
login.locked: Sign-in is temporarily locked. Try again in {minutes} minutes.

add.title: Add content
add.description: Supports public web pages, documents, and public GitHub repositories. Completed items may appear in public answers.
add.configureDescription: Both chat and embedding models must be available before adding content.
add.error: Could not add the item. Try again later.
add.networkError: Could not add the item. Check the connection and retry.

library.title: Library
library.description: Browse every item and combine keyword, tag, and processing-status filters.
library.noMatch: No items match the current filters

detail.savingError: Could not save. Try again later.
detail.savingNetworkError: Could not save. Check the connection and retry.
detail.refetchError: Could not refetch. Try again later.
detail.refetchNetworkError: Could not refetch. Check the connection and retry.
detail.deleteError: Delete failed. The item was kept.
detail.actionsDescription: Refetch retrieves the public content again; manual summaries are never overwritten automatically.
detail.deleteDescription: This removes the vector and public-search source and cannot be undone.

category.title: Primary category
category.label: Choose one primary category
category.saved: Manual category saved. AI will not overwrite it.
category.conflict: The item changed. Refresh before choosing again.
category.error: Could not save the category. The previous choice was restored.

categories.title: Category management
categories.description: Maintain fixed categories, review AI proposals, and track automatic reclassification.
categories.protectionBody: AI only changes automatically categorized items. A merge or delete involving manual items stops the entire batch.
categories.supplementBody: Suggest additions only for routine maintenance.
categories.fullBody: May suggest additions, renames, merges, and deletes. Every change is reviewed first.
categories.noSuggestions: There are no applicable proposals this time.
categories.aiUnavailable: AI is temporarily unavailable. Existing categories were not changed.
categories.proposalError: The proposal could not be parsed safely. Try again later.
categories.confirmProtection: Only category_manual=false items are processed. Manual categories are never migrated.
categories.deleteDescription: Deleting “{name}” moves its {count} items to unclassified.
categories.deleteManual: {count} manual items keep their manual-protection flag.
categories.manualConflict: This category has manually categorized items. Migrate them first or ignore this proposal.
categories.stale: Categories changed. Generate a new proposal.
categories.applyError: Changes were not applied. Review the preview and retry.
categories.applyNetworkError: The connection was interrupted. Retrying reuses the same request and cannot duplicate writes.
categories.crudError: The category operation failed. Existing data was kept.
categories.deleted: Category deleted. Related items moved to unclassified.

models.title: Model configuration
models.error: Connection failed. The existing configuration was not changed.
models.rebuilding: Vectors are rebuilding, so public search is unavailable. It will resume automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage models, automation, public quotas, security, Telegram, and language.

refetch.title: Scheduled refetch
refetch.description: Check completed items on an interval and update summaries and vectors when content changes.

rate.title: Public question limits
rate.description: The server enforces daily per-IP and site-wide quotas.

security.title: Security
security.description: Changing the password revokes this session and every other session. Sign in again with the new password.
security.error: Password unchanged. Check the current password and strength.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: The Bot Token is encrypted. Only allowlisted user IDs receive a response.
telegram.allowedIds: Allowed user IDs (comma or newline separated)
telegram.error: The configuration is invalid or could not be saved.

locale.title: Language
locale.description: The public and admin interfaces share one language. AI summaries and answers remain Chinese.
